source: docs/EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md, '## Ground truth'. FROZEN alongside the protocol: changing a value here without logging the reason in docs/DECISIONS.md and rerunning the experiment from scratch invalidates any result already produced.
note: Full cross product: every one of the 7 policy-grid rows (packages/contracts/data/policy-grid.json) crossed with every one of the 5 RecoveryAction values, 35 entries. Not just each cell's own designated action, because EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md's control arm is explicitly grid-unaware ('retry immediately, up to 3 attempts, no grid awareness') and always applies retry_with_backoff regardless of which action the cell's own row actually names -- so a mismatched-action probability is a real, load-bearing number, not a hypothetical. RULE 1: nudge_no_auto_retry and never_retry are 0.0 for every cell, always. This is a MODELLING CHOICE, not a claim that nudges are ineffective in reality: this population scores only whether the one modelled attempt recovers, and neither action re-presents the payment within that attempt, so no recovery event can occur through it in this world. RULE 2: the terminal cell (business/payment_initiation) is 0.0 for every action with no exceptions -- it fails identically regardless of mechanism, by definition of terminal. RULE 3 (the load-bearing one): for the other 5 cells, the cell's own grid-designated action gets its best-match probability ('home'); the other two retry actions get a lower, individually-reasoned 'mismatched retry' probability -- what happens when that specific wrong tool is applied to that specific failure. retry_with_backoff on a cell whose home action is something else is the economically important mismatch, since it is literally what the control arm does on every cell, every time.

weighted_true_lift.status: CORRECTED 2026-08-27 (docs/DECISIONS.md). A first, hand-computed draft of this block (single-attempt, raw config values, no accounting for how modulation actually averages over customer_prior's real distribution) is WRONG and has been replaced. Never hand-compute this block again -- it must always be regenerated from apps/engine/src/revenant_engine/true_lift.py's compute_true_lift(), and cross-checked against tests/test_true_lift.py's independent Monte Carlo simulation before being copied in here.
weighted_true_lift.method: compute_true_lift() computes a REALISED expectation, not raw-config arithmetic: for each cell, control_realised_probability and treatment_realised_probability are each E over customer_prior ~ Beta(2,3) of 'recovers within K i.i.d. attempts at that customer's own modulated probability' (1 - (1-modulated_probability(p_true, prior))^K), integrated numerically (scipy.integrate.quad) rather than assumed equal to the raw config p_true. K (attempts_for_action) is pinned in EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md's '## Assignment': 3 for a retry action, 0 for nudge_no_auto_retry/never_retry. Each cell is then weighted by its population share (grid_cell_weights -- taxonomy-derived counts of 2, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 1 out of 11, internal/* floored) and (treatment_realised - control_realised) summed. IMPORTANT: a config true_recovery_probability value does NOT equal what the population realises -- e.g. gateway/payment_authorization's configured 0.55 realises 0.8289 once compounded over up to 3 attempts and averaged over the real Beta(2,3) distribution (modulated_probability centers its shift at logit(mean(Beta(2,3))) = logit(0.4) = -0.4055, but E[logit(Beta(2,3))] = -0.5 exactly, a real Jensen's-inequality gap that does not cancel out in aggregate). Never read a config probability as a population rate.

weighted_true_lift.positive_contribution_detail: gateway/authentication (2.98pp) + bank/payment_authorization (6.34pp), where control's zero-delay blind retry realises a materially lower recovery rate than the targeted action even after both are compounded over up to 3 attempts
weighted_true_lift.negative_contribution_detail: customer/payment_authorization (-3.12pp) + customer/payment_authentication (-0.73pp). Larger in magnitude than a single-attempt calculation suggests, because control's small per-attempt probability compounds over up to 3 attempts (0.03 configured -> 0.1145 realised on customer/payment_authorization) while treatment's nudge_no_auto_retry stays exactly 0.0 regardless of attempt count.
weighted_true_lift.negative_contribution_reason: Structural, not an error: nudge_no_auto_retry (the correct, grid-aware action on both customer cells) realises exactly 0.0 by RULE 1 at any attempt count, because it never re-presents the payment -- so correctly declining a futile retry cannot itself register as a recovery here, even though control's blind zero-delay retry gets up to 3 tries to get lucky on the same cell. The measured true lift therefore UNDERSTATES whatever a full multi-attempt policy simulation would show, and the bias runs against the treatment arm, never for it.
weighted_true_lift.net_detail: 9.32 - 3.85 = 5.47pp, computed by compute_true_lift() and cross-checked against an independent Monte Carlo simulation (tests/test_true_lift.py, N=400,000, agrees within 5 standard errors per cell and in total) before being recorded here. Still sits within EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md's stated 5-8pp target range (just inside the lower edge) and close to its own power analysis's 6pp detection threshold -- near the edge of what the design can detect, not a signal so large the calibration check's confidence interval would trivially avoid zero on every run.

HOME action. An authentication-step failure (e.g. a 3DS/OTP hiccup) is often the METHOD's problem, not the gateway's: prompting an alternate authentication instrument sidesteps whatever specifically broke. Set slightly below the pure-infra gateway/payment_authorization cell (0.55), since authentication friction is somewhat less mechanically clean than a plain transient blip.

MISMATCHED -- what the control arm applies here, load-bearing. Resubmitting the SAME auth method into the SAME failure mostly just fails again. Also: control retries with ZERO delay (CONTROL_ARM_GUARDRAIL_CONFIG.attemptSpacing.baseMs = 0, apps/gateway/src/guardrails/config.ts), so there is not even time for a transient auth-server hiccup to clear on its own before the retry fires. Gap vs. home (0.48-0.18=0.30) is the largest single mismatch in the table -- this cell is where being grid-aware matters most.
